reviews.text: My dog loves their in house treats in the shape of a squirrel.

Everyone there is incredibly kind and sincere. You can tell they really care about your dog and their needs. It's out of the way for me. But I go back there because of the incredible care and customer service offered.
Great variety of options for accessories, toys, treats, and food. Very friendly staff, will definitely be looking forward to coming back.

An absolute “Must Visit” if you love your dog. Lucky Dog Barkery offers an exceptional selection of high quality treats and food for your K9 family member. There are many more pleasant (even necessary) surprises inside. We recently found a very well made travel carrier for our boy (that was simply not available at “big box” stores). All the goodness is enhanced by the most friendly, knowledgeable staff to be found. We now realize that there’s no need to stop elsewhere-it’s straight to “The Barkery” for us when we’re in town.
Amazing store with huge selection of premium food and many toys and treats to choose from.
A great store with a lot of unique and fun items.
Staff is always friendly and helpful.
Just a little expensive
Please correct website. It say OPEN, but when I arrived at store it was closed with a paper sign on the door. It helps to keep website current. Thanks

Quaint pet supply shop, I found on a Google search. The gentleman I spoke with was very helpful and friendly. I made the 80 mile round trip for a specific food item. Unfortunately, they didn't stock what I was looking for. However, I will definitely visit again when I have time to browse.

I came in for the first time trying to look for a cake for my baby and the place is amazing the staff educated me on which cake to get for his size and helped me pick out his little hat too, they also have a lot of good quality food. It’s alittle pricey but when it comes to my fur babies they always get the best!
Came back 3 months later for another cake, then again in October for another one!

Pete loves coming to the shop for ultra high quality treats and service. The staff is very friendly and always make Pete feel welcomed .

He got a cute bow tie
Thank you, Dwayne!
Got my pup a birthday cake here and it was a big hit for all the pups who attended.

This was my first time here at Lucky dog bakery. I’ve been in Mini pet stores in my lifetime. However, this one stands out from it all. as soon as I walked in, I was greeted with such it charismatic, friendly and welcoming attitude by Gabrielle, Braden and Ben. I was only there to look around but ended up walking out with a really cool one-of-a-kind hat and also some treats for my puppy. They Helped me out tremendously and even gave my puppy treats to that made him happy. Without a doubt, this is The best pet store in The entire world if. If you’re looking for something different something unique and fun then this is your first stop.

It's the second year in a row that I got a birthday cake for my dog here. The ingredients are super clean, and my dog devoured it again! The proverbial icing on the cake is that the staff is incredibly friendly. Going to Lucky Dog Barkery is an experience!
Our dogs love this store. Great selection of treats and toys
Stopped by today to grab some goodies for my 5 dogs - super impressed by all the offerings!! The staff was also wonderful and so kind. Needless to say my pups are stocked for a while. :)
Awesome little pet shop. Lots of specialty stuff I don't see at big name pet stores. Ill definitely stop by anytime I'm in the area
Clean exterior. Tidy interior. Cheerful environment. Helpful staff.
Adorable pet store tailored to your all your dog’s desires
Great place for a large selection of clothes, treats, and food. I love stopping by when I'm in the neighborhood. Staff is always friendly and kind.

This is an amazing pet store. The staff each one so knowledgeable, so passionate.I'm so enthusiastic to help. Best store I have ever been into. They have some amazing organic food products. Small batch is an amazing food for dogs.They have so many options. I am always impressed with my purchases And the staff

I take my dog here every time he goes to the vet as a reward! They have great toys, a huge range of good dog food, and lots of great treats including bully sticks. I even got him his first birthday “cake” here as well as his doggy life jacket. The employees are always so friendly - Sergio loves all the attention they give him!

I am so happy I came across this shop! The selections are plentiful and curated well. The staff spent time educating me on different meal options and stimulating game options for my dog. There are plenty healthy options at Lucky Dog Barkery to choose from for your pet. I came once and picked up a few healthy snacks for my pet and the staff kindly provided a few healthy meal samples for her to try as well. She loved them! I returned and picked up the full meals for her. I can’t say enough how kind and knowledgeable the folks are that work here. You should try Lucky Dog Barkery—highly recommend!

I absolutely love Lucky Dog Bakery! As a new pet parent, I visited the store to prepare for my puppy's arrival, and Braden was incredibly helpful in guiding me through picking out all the essentials. I never felt pressured to buy anything unnecessary—in fact, they even gave me a complimentary puppy starter pack filled with toys and treats to try out with my new pup!

Every time I visit, the staff is always friendly and knowledgeable, making it feel like a true neighborhood gem. I’m so happy I found this place, thanks to the glowing reviews from others. It’s now my go-to shop for all things puppy-related!

I was on the hunt for specialty supplements and food for my 3yr old Mini Aussie that has a genetic joint disease and has been experiencing awful flair ups. The vet kept prescribing rx's that didn't help! We found Lucky Dog Barkery and words …
